messages.subject: Re: control.predictor = list(link=...)
parts:
Oh, I think I got the answer from INLA website:

Automatically. In the case you want to use the link-function from the likelihood already used (most often the case), there is the argument 'link' in 'control.predictor'. If the response y[idx] = NA, then set link[idx] = 1, to indicate that you want to compute that fitted value using the link function from 'family[1]'.
